correctness.rationale: For the displayed N=1 presentation, independently rebuilt the class-four free metabelian Hall basis with weights 5,10,40,105 (160 columns), expanded the three relators through generator adjoints, killed all weight-four basis terms except u_1,u_2,u_3, and imposed u_1=16u_3, u_2=4u_3, 64u_3=0. This creates a 483-by-160 integer relation matrix. Independent exact Smith normal form yields 155 nonzero diagonal factors and five free generators, with torsion counts {2:1,4:22,8:1,16:15,64:7,256:3}; modular ranks 106 over F_2 and 155 over F_3 corroborate divisibility factors. Weighted exponent 1+44+3+60+42+24=174, largest factor 256. Closure under adjoint action generates the ideal through nilpotency class four, so the matrix presents the claimed quotient. Qualification: the actual original article full text could not be accessed to independently compare every source relator against Example 3.2, though all relators and the quotient are explicit in the frozen RESULT.md; the computation is exact, not a probabilistic finite sample.
